# Debian and Ubuntu (checked against Debian 13 "trixie" and Ubuntu 24.04): sudo apt-get install ...
# Build tools for the C++ engines
build-essential
cmake
ninja-build
git
curl
pkg-config
glslc            # Vulkan builds (AEN_GPU=vulkan)
libvulkan-dev    # Vulkan builds
# Runtime helpers
ffmpeg           # sound mastering, previews
bubblewrap       # the sandbox for the explicit tools
nodejs           # Mermaid, Vega-Lite, Ink, gltfpack
npm
ruby             # Sonic Pi's recorder when Sonic Pi brings no Ruby of its own
libcairo2-dev    # manim (pycairo)
libpango1.0-dev  # manim (ManimPango)
# Explicit tools
imagemagick
graphviz
resvg
librsvg2-bin     # rsvg-convert
fluidsynth
abcmidi
lilypond
csound
faust
sox
lame
supercollider-language   # sclang
openscad
colmap
tiled            # tiled and tmxrasterizer
blender
gimp
# Not in the Debian/Ubuntu archive (install by hand if you need them):
#   d2: https://d2lang.com (curl -fsSL https://d2lang.com/install.sh | sh -s --)
#   basisu: https://github.com/BinomialLLC/basis_universal/releases
#   .NET SDK 8+ (Yarn Spinner): Ubuntu: sudo apt install dotnet-sdk-8.0; Debian: https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/core/install/linux
#   Godot 4: https://godotengine.org/download (the archive has only Godot 3)
#   Sonic Pi 5: https://sonic-pi.net (the archive has Sonic Pi 3)
